newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges down, but lacks direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges down, but lacks direction.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices were slightly lower in late trading on Friday, but brokers said the market lacked direction.
July Brent crude futures on SIMEX traded 102 lots at $19.47 per barrel, two cents higher than London's close. August was quoted at $19.45/$19.53, versus London's $19.50 settlement.
Brokers said the market was technically supported, but lacked any momentum to test higher prices.
"There's no real direction," one broker said.
NYMEX crude prices were slightly lower on ACCESS after-hours screen trading.
June was last traded at $21.27, down three cents from New York, while July was last traded at $21.22, down seven cents.
